caption: The drawing depicts a central seated figure with curled dark hair, draped in a long, flowing robe shaded in beige, brown, and gray tones with dark outlines. The figure holds a large goblet or chalice in their left hand, containing a circular object with a cross inside and radiating lines around it. In their right hand, the figure grasps a tall tower or building that features a pointed roof, a flag, a circular window, and an arched doorway. The background of the drawing is filled with a muted tan wash. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller scene showing a bird with outstretched wings and lines radiating downward from what appears to be a hand. At the bottom left and right of the figure, there are two floral arrangements with three distinct flowers each. The drawing is enclosed within a loosely defined dark border with irregular lines. The palette consists mainly of sepia, brown, beige, and black.
title: Wall Hanging of Santa Barbara
